fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. Street View (2023) shows an open driveway from US Highway 130 with no barrier arm or sliding gate; the gravel trailer yard has a low chainlink fence but the property entrance off US-130 is open. A 'For Lease' sign was still posted in 2023, consistent with this being a recently-acquired (2024-25) terminal.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible anywhere on the property in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Building appears to be an office/maintenance-type structure with at most a few dock/service doors on the NE face; 0-10 band, flagged uncertain — this is a transload/maintenance terminal, not a dock-intensive warehouse.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large unpaved gravel trailer-storage yard NE of the building; satellite shows ~45 trailers parked in rows, 25-50 band. Matches the dossier's '25 tractors, 80 trailers' transload hub description.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated gravel trailer-storage lot is the dominant yard feature.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long open driveway/apron from US-130 into the gravel yard, ample room for a multi-truck queue with no congestion.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Florence NJ along US-130 with farmland and open land adjacent; classed Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NW of the property but no spur enters the parcel.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single irregular L-shaped building (office/maintenance shop) plus the open trailer yard.
